author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Persevering face mirrored about x=24: r20 rim, squeezed-shut open chevron eyes (brow arm + eye arm), frown arc; features 9 clear of the rim. Lucide circle-face construction (frown/angry).
omissions: Each slanted brow and flat eye line pair is merged into one open chevron; a brow and an eye line cannot sit 8 apart within the 11-unit feature radius. The frown is narrower than the reference's for the same reason.
